title: under the omit title policy the only handle on an alert is the hashed id, and no tool in the repo resolves that id to a meeting (contract W9)
evidence: grep for alertIdFor and buildAttentionAlerts across the worktree (ts, tsx, mjs) finds only packages/meeting-bot/src/calendar/*. No operations view, API route or script maps an attn id (first 20 hex of SHA-256 over the UTF-16LE session key) back to a session key or meeting. Under omit the alert carries headline, formatted start time and the id only, so an operator can tell two alerts apart (different keys give different ids; tested) but cannot find the meeting from the alert alone unless the wiring unit supplies an id-to-key map.
fix_direction: Wiring unit: keep an id-to-sessionKey map next to the sent-keys state and expose it in the operations view (or a small lookup script), or supply a non-sensitive identifier per W8(b) (calendar name, organiser display name). This unit deliberately adds no lookup tool.
